# bob capture-targets

List capture routes for inbox, area, project, and record notes

```text title="bob capture-targets --help"
List the routable Bob notes that capture pickers can offer.

The command reads top-level area and non-terminal project notes, plus configured record folders. It always pins mac_inbox first as the default task-capture target. It is read-only.

Usage: bob capture-targets [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -v, --verbose
          Print skipped non-routable note warnings to stderr

Examples:
  bob capture-targets --format json
  bob capture-targets
  bob capture-targets -f json
  bob capture-targets -b ~/bob
```
